what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Burkina Faso in the Niger: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 47578 Burkinabe asylum seekers in the Niger, 68.1% of all asylum seekers from Burkina Faso.
Refugees from Burkina Faso, a separate group, live mostly in Mali, Côte d'Ivoire, Togo and Ghana.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Burkina Faso with JNIM from 2018 to 2025, at war level in some of those years.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Burkina Faso from 2019 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2022 at 24981 asylum seekers.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the Niger.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the Niger only.
